definition: Public-sector pension institution whose own accounts must be separated from RGSS and consolidated public-finance measures
ambiguous_label_guard: CGA must not be used as a synonym for general government
notes: Closed to new subscribers from 2006 and closure effects must be modeled separately

definition: General Social Security regime whose contribution rates cover multiple contingencies and are not automatically pension-only
ambiguous_label_guard: RGSS must not be used as a pension-only benchmark without rate decomposition
notes: Use decomposed pension-risk benchmarks for CGA comparisons

definition: Contributory Social Security subsystem not identical to consolidated Social Security or general government
ambiguous_label_guard: Previdential balance must state whether other subsystems and transfers are excluded
notes: Perimeter must be declared for combined-balance calculations

definition: State Budget transfer to a pension institution that may be balancing specific extraordinary or formulaic
institutional_perimeter: State to CGA or Social Security
ambiguous_label_guard: Transfer must name payer recipient legal basis and consolidation perimeter
notes: A transfer is not by itself evidence of legal non-compliance

definition: Public transfer other than the main State Budget transfer recorded in the receiving institutional accounts
institutional_perimeter: Public sector to CGA or Social Security
ambiguous_label_guard: Transfer must name payer recipient legal basis and consolidation perimeter
notes: Keep separate from State Budget transfers unless the source aggregates them

definition: Worker-side contribution legally due withheld or received depending on measurement field
ambiguous_label_guard: Contribution must state legal due withheld or cash-received measurement
notes: Do not merge legal liability payroll withholding and recorded receipt

definition: Employer-side contribution legally due or recorded as received by applicable employer class and period
ambiguous_label_guard: Contribution must state employer class and legal or economic benchmark basis
notes: Legal gap and economic benchmark gap are distinct concepts

definition: Pension benefit expenditure recorded by the paying institution for the stated population and period
institutional_perimeter: CGA or Social Security institutional accounts
ambiguous_label_guard: Expenditure must state beneficiary population and paying institution
notes: Do not combine with liabilities or actuarial present values

definition: Non-pension benefit expenditure recorded by the institution
institutional_perimeter: CGA or Social Security institutional accounts
ambiguous_label_guard: Benefit labels must state pension versus non-pension scope
notes: Keep outside pension expenditure unless source aggregation requires disclosure

definition: Administrative operating cost of the pension institution or special regime ledger
institutional_perimeter: CGA or Social Security institutional accounts
ambiguous_label_guard: Administration costs must not be interpreted as benefit payments
notes: Use separate cost bucket in identities

definition: Investment or asset income attributable to the institutional ledger or transferred-asset reserve
institutional_perimeter: CGA Social Security or special regime accounts
ambiguous_label_guard: Income must state whether accrued or cash received
notes: Do not net against expenditure before reconciliation

definition: Use of transferred assets or reserve assets to finance pension payments
ambiguous_label_guard: Asset use must identify stock source and receiving payment ledger
notes: Separate financing source from expenditure

definition: Residual financing source explicitly identified outside transfers income or asset drawdown
ambiguous_label_guard: Financing label must name source or remain unresolved
notes: Do not treat residual financing as causal evidence

definition: Timing or accrual-to-cash adjustment needed to reconcile legal due withheld received and account-recognized amounts
ambiguous_label_guard: Adjustment must state direction and bridge basis
notes: Timing adjustments cannot be presented as missing remittance without source support

definition: Identity residual after recorded components are applied under the stated sign convention
ambiguous_label_guard: Deficit or balance labels must state identity and perimeter
notes: Residuals are diagnostics not substantive findings

definition: National-accounts deficit concept under ESA standards distinct from institutional cash balances
ambiguous_label_guard: Deficit must state ESA version perimeter and sign
notes: ESA-95 and ESA-2010 treatments may classify the same transaction differently

definition: Assets transferred from bank pension funds to the State in connection with specified pension liabilities
ambiguous_label_guard: Asset transfer must be paired with liability perimeter and valuation date
notes: Must be tracked with corresponding pension obligations

definition: Present value or legal valuation of pension obligations for the stated population valuation date and discount basis
institutional_perimeter: CGA Social Security banks or general government depending on row
ambiguous_label_guard: Liability must state discount rate mortality and population perimeter
notes: Do not compare directly with cash expenditure

definition: Gap between a legal contribution obligation and recorded or withheld amount after timing base and perimeter adjustments
institutional_perimeter: CGA or RGSS legal compliance perimeter
ambiguous_label_guard: Gap must distinguish legal compliance from economic benchmark
notes: Requires source-supported obligation and receipt fields

definition: Gap between observed employer contribution revenue and an economic benchmark rate calculation
ambiguous_label_guard: Benchmark gap must not be described as legal non-compliance
notes: Keep separate from legal gap
